sections.name: summary
sections.value: Wire tree-sitter-javascript into fs3-parsers so .js/.mjs/.cjs/.jsx files stop indexing as one bare `unknown` file element (verified live 2026-11-14: `flowspace3 search` returns dodo-gogo game/impact/lib/game/classes/branch-pool.js as kind=file, subkind=unknown). The twin of plan 015 (whose non-goals named JS/JSX as 'separate packet; tree-sitter-javascript is a different crate'). The packet is: the grammar crate and one Language::JavaScript entry, a widening of the generic value-shape rule so pre-ES6 callables (object-literal `key: function(){}` pairs, function-valued assignments `exports.x = () => {}`, JS class fields) become Function elements named by their binding, golden whole-tree fixtures with mutation receipts, the PARSER_VERSION bump, docs + add-language skill drift fix, and a real-usage receipt against a read-only copy of ~/GitHub/dodo-gogo (ImpactJS).

sections.name: goals
value: `.js`/`.mjs`/`.cjs`/`.jsx` → Language::JavaScript (one grammar; JSX lives in tree-sitter-javascript); the file element's subkind reports `javascript`

function / generator / async function declarations, classes (declaration and named class expressions), methods (incl. getters/setters, static, private `#m`, object-literal method shorthand) become named elements with correct addresses and 1-based spans

callables bound by value become Function elements named by their binding via the existing generic value-shape rule, widened language-agnostically: `const f = () => {}`, `let g = function(){}`, JS class-field arrows (`field_definition`), object-literal pairs (`init: function(){}`), and function-valued assignments (`exports.h = async () => {}`, `Foo.prototype.bar = function(){}` named `bar`)
a real ImpactJS file (dodo-gogo game/impact/lib/game/main.js and peers) yields function-level elements (init/update/draw…) instead of one bare file element
golden whole-tree fixtures + invents-nothing negatives + mutation receipts for every decision; Rust/Python/TypeScript/TSX goldens byte-unchanged

sections.name: non_goals
value: treating `X = Base.extend({...})` (ImpactJS/Backbone-style class factories) as Container elements — a framework call-pattern heuristic would be a per-pattern special case (o-prime ruling 3, 2026-11-14); their methods still surface as file-scoped Functions
Flow / JSDoc type semantics, CommonJS `require` resolution, or any cross-file reference work
routing JS through the TypeScript grammar (rejected — see key findings)
changing ElementKind, the store schema, embeddings, discovery candidacy, or any CLI envelope
augmented assignments (`x ||= function(){}`), destructuring patterns, computed property keys (`[k]: fn`) as elements — nameless or ambiguous, spliced through
opening an upstream issue or the PR, or re-ingesting any live daemon — Vaughan's go via the o-prime; the live 0.7.0 daemon (:7373/:5433) is never touched

naming the object a literal method belongs to: `{ get(){}, put: () => {} }` yields `file::get` / `file::put` (the object is not a declaration, so the splice rule attaches its callables to the nearest real ancestor — consistent with ruling 3 and 015 review f-2b01)

value.claim: `Language::for_extension` maps js|mjs|cjs|jsx (any case) → JavaScript and `as_str()` = "javascript"; `sample.js` and `sample.jsx` fixtures scan to trees whose language is javascript and whose whole forest matches a checked-in golden (functions, generators, async, classes, class expressions, methods incl. get/set/static/#private, nested functions, export default) with correct addresses and 1-based spans; both fixtures parse with `has_error == false` (no ScanError::Unparseable, no recovery)
value.receipt: js/mjs/cjs/jsx map to JavaScript; JS/JSX whole-tree goldens pass cleanly

value.claim: the generic value-shape rule in source.rs (no `Language::` branch) promotes function-valued `field_definition`, `pair` and `assignment_expression` to Function elements named by their binding's own short name: a `left` names only when it is an `identifier` or a `member_expression` (→ its `property`); a `key`/`property` names only when it is an identifier-kind or a string (string → unquoted, unquoting confined to these binding names so no other grammar's names change); subscript lefts (`a[k] = fn`), computed keys, destructuring and non-function values are not elements; deleting each widening (and the left-kind guard) turns the JS golden red (mutation receipt per rule)
value.receipt: generic field/pair/assignment rule green; seven isolated mutations red then restored green

value.claim: invents-nothing: grep-traps in the fixtures ("function"/"class" inside strings, comments and template literals; callback arrows passed as arguments; IIFEs; `const n = 42`; `this.x = 5`; anonymous default-export class) yield no element, and no element has an empty name or address
value.receipt: JavaScript invents-nothing and non-empty identity test passes

value.claim: no regression: `git diff b7774df...HEAD -- crates/parsers/tests/fixture_elements.rs crates/parsers/fixtures/sample.rs crates/parsers/fixtures/sample.py crates/parsers/fixtures/sample.ts crates/parsers/fixtures/sample.tsx crates/parsers/fixtures/sample.md` shows no removed lines in the .rs test file and an empty diff for the five fixtures (base pinned to the approved base b7774df, not the moving origin/main); any changed expectation row would be listed with its reason (o-prime rider 3); `harness checks` (fmt, clippy -D warnings, test, arch drift) green in the stream worktree
value.receipt: existing fixtures unchanged; no removed expectation lines; parser tests and harness checks green

value.claim: PARSER_VERSION is bumped fs3-parsers@4 → @5 with a history line naming plan 020, and the drafted PR body `docs/plans/020-js-grammar/assets/pr-body.md` names (i) the one-off consequence that since #180 a bump makes every daemon reparse every registered root on next boot, and (ii) that TypeScript files gain the same pair/assignment callables (o-prime ruling 1)
value.receipt: PARSER_VERSION @5; PR body names #180 root reparse and TypeScript pair/assignment gain

value.claim: real usage: a throwaway scratch probe (never shipped) scanning every .js file of a read-only copy of ~/GitHub/dodo-gogo through fs3-parsers reports per file: language, element count before (b7774df: exactly 1, unknown) vs after, and the count of callable syntax nodes (function_declaration / generator_function_declaration / method_definition / class_declaration, plus arrow_function / function_expression / generator_function whose parent is a variable_declarator, field_definition, pair or assignment_expression); acceptance = 0 scan errors, after-count ≥ 1 + callable-node count minus nameless ones listed with reason for every file, and game/impact/lib/game/main.js yields Function elements init, update and draw
value.receipt: dodo-gogo: 84/84 files, 84 to 1170 elements, 1100 callable nodes, 14 nameless listed, 0 scan errors; main init/update/draw

value.claim: docs: scanner.md names JavaScript in the grammar set and the widened value-shape rule; add-language SKILL.md lists the PARSER_VERSION bump as a recipe step
value.receipt: scanner and parser docs name JavaScript/value-shape rule; add-language recipe includes PARSER_VERSION

sections.name: implementation_summary
sections.value: One phase, one coder. Prove tree-sitter-javascript 0.25 builds against the workspace's tree-sitter 0.26 first; wire Language::JavaScript; write sample.js/sample.jsx goldens (RED); widen the generic value-shape rule (binding kinds + value/name fields) until green, with a mutation receipt per widening; prove the four existing code goldens are untouched; bump PARSER_VERSION; update docs + skill; finish with a scratch real-usage probe over a read-only dodo-gogo copy. Expected: every JS file in dodo-gogo gains function-level elements, zero behavioural change for Rust/Python/TS/TSX fixtures.

value.finding: tree-sitter-javascript 0.25.0 is the latest crate; it depends on tree-sitter-language ^0.1 (the same ABI shim tree-sitter-typescript 0.23.2 uses under the workspace's tree-sitter 0.26), so it should link — but 015 found build resolution worth proving first.
value.action: T001 proves `cargo build -p fs3-parsers` resolves before any other work; on failure stop and report (do not bump tree-sitter).

value.finding: Design call: dedicated grammar vs routing JS through tree-sitter-typescript. TS grammar mis-parses valid JS (`a < b > (c)` generic-call ambiguity; `<T>x` casts vs JSX in .js) and would make the file subkind lie (`typescript` for a .js file).
value.action: Dedicated `tree-sitter-javascript` crate, one Language::JavaScript for js|mjs|cjs|jsx (JSX is in the JS grammar; no separate Jsx variant needed because there is no TS-style grammar split).

value.finding: JS names its nodes differently from TS: class fields are `field_definition` with the name in `property` (TS: `public_field_definition`/`name`); object-literal pairs carry `key`/`value`; assignments carry `left`/`right`. The current rule reads only `value` and NAME_FIELDS lacks key/property/left.
value.action: Widen source.rs generically: FUNCTION_BINDINGS += field_definition, pair, assignment_expression; the value field becomes a small ordered list (value, right); binding names come from key/property/left with a kind guard — left: identifier, or member_expression → its `property`; key/property: identifier-kinds or string (unquoted here only, never in first_identifier_text, so TS `declare module "pkg"` and every existing name are untouched); anything else (subscript, computed, pattern) → nameless → spliced. Keep `type` last in NAME_FIELDS (L3).

value.finding: `pair` and `assignment_expression` also exist in tree-sitter-typescript (and Python has a dictionary `pair`), so the widening changes behaviour beyond JS. sample.ts/sample.tsx contain no function-valued pair/assignment, and Python `pair` values are never arrow/function_expression kinds — so existing goldens should be byte-unchanged; TS code in the wild gains object-literal/assignment methods (an intended, generic improvement).
value.action: AC-0004 diff check; one source.rs unit test shows the same rule firing on a .ts snippet (proves no Language branch); call the TS gain out in the PR body.

value.finding: Classification needs no classify.rs change: function_declaration/generator_function_declaration/method_definition/class_declaration classify today; `class` (class expression) is a BARE_DECL; field_definition/lexical_declaration/variable_declaration have decl suffixes but no category hint → None; function_expression/arrow_function are not declaration-shaped.
value.action: Do not touch crates/core/src/classify.rs; a parsers-side test enumerates the JS node-kind decisions (incl. deliberate non-elements) via fs3_core::classify.

value.finding: PARSER_VERSION bump (recipe step) + #180 means every daemon reparses every root on next boot after upgrade; enrichment is keyed by raw_hash, so only NEW JS elements cost provider calls (summaries/embeddings) on repos with JS.
value.action: Bump @4→@5 with history line; PR body names the consequence (o-prime ruling 1).

value.risk: grammar crate fails to link with tree-sitter 0.26
value.mitigation: T001 first; stop-and-report, never bump tree-sitter in this plan

value.risk: widened NAME_FIELDS/value fields change a node in another grammar that already classifies
value.mitigation: existing goldens must stay byte-identical (AC-0004); fields appended before `type`, only consulted for nodes with no earlier name field

value.risk: assignment rule over-promotes (`module.exports = function(){}` → element named `exports`)
value.mitigation: accepted: addresses are non-unique by design and the element is still a real callable; pinned in the golden so the behaviour is deliberate

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Stay inside the fence: crates/parsers/**, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, crates/testkit/arch-allowlist.toml, crates/daemon/src/scan.rs (PARSER_VERSION only), docs/services/scanner.md, .agents/skills/add-language/SKILL.md, docs/plans/020-js-grammar/**, scratch .harness/temp/s020-js-grammar/**. crates/core/src/classify.rs only if a test proves it necessary — stop and report first.

Never stop/restart/reconfigure the live flowspace3 daemon (:7373) or its db (:5433); never use ~/.local/bin/flowspace3 for test work; ~/GitHub/dodo-gogo is read-only (copy it to scratch for the probe).
No `Language::` branch in source.rs (PRD req 21); fixture + expectation land in the same commit as the wiring.
Commits via `harness commit` with conventional subjects (feat(parsers): …, docs: …); never stage the-flow.json/the-flow.md by hand-edit, target/, or .harness/temp/.
Heavy cargo runs niced (C12) with a wall-clock cap: perl -e 'alarm shift @ARGV; exec @ARGV' 1800 nice -n 19 <cmd>.
